{{Top|leg}}
'''The Landing Lights''' was a dingy [[Cantina/Legends|cafe]] located on the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Haven (spaceport moon)|Haven]]. Around [[39 BBY]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] visited the cafe while attempting to contact the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and waiting out a [[Meteorite/Legends|meteor]] storm.<ref name="Secrets of the Jedi">[[Secrets of the Jedi (novel)|''Secrets of the Jedi'']]</ref>
